name: Issue 3562: Steam Conjurer casts Wild Steam off Weapon Engraving: Earth damage
contract: Steam Conjurer 805743 (APPLY_AURA/PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL, EffectTriggerSpell[0]=803737 'Wild Steam') has native
ProcFlags=0 in Spell.dbc, so before the merged fix it never procced. PR #5328
adds a spell_proc row for 805743 (family 38, mask1=0x00020000 matching Earth Engraving's own proc-spell
classmask, Cooldown=3000ms, matching 'once every 3 sec'), plus a spell_linked_spell row so Earth Engraving
653219 grants its proc aura 653221, and a spell_proc row for 653221 itself (ProcFlags=0x00010154) so it
fires on melee/ranged/spell hits and casts Weapon Engraving: Earth damage (653272). With Steam Conjurer
learned on top of that chain, landing Earth-engraved auto attacks should cast Wild Steam (803737) with the
3s internal cooldown limiting it to at most one cast per 3 seconds of sustained hits.
Verification note: Steam Conjurer's own Spell.dbc ProcChance is 5% (kept as-is by the migration's Chance 0),
so at the draft's ~9 observed Earth Engraving procs the chance of zero Wild Steam casts is ~0.95^9 ~= 63%
- an unreliable single-run sample. This extends sustained combat to five Earthen Fists refresh cycles (~45s
of attacking) to raise the Earth Engraving proc count several-fold and correspondingly shrink the residual
chance of a false negative, while still failing outright (zero Wild Steam casts across dozens of engraving
procs) if the proc row's wiring were actually broken.

steps.label: A fast dagger lands many swings

Earth Engraving, the equip spell of the Weapon Engraving: Earth enchant
CONTRACT: Earth Engraving grants its proc aura
SETUP: the proc chance rises from 15 to 65
CONTRACT: direct damage procs Earth Engraving
CONTRACT: the proc deals Weapon Engraving: Earth damage to the target
CONTRACT: Steam Conjurer casts Wild Steam off that engraving damage
CONTRACT: Wild Steam actually lands on the target
